cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.

mechanism: A directs an introduction to an invisible guest and takes over seating work to keep B carrying out ordinary hospitality.
confusable: Unlike describing the imaginary guest, A needs B to perform the introduction and preserve its place at dinner.
comparison: Invisible guest identification and Mum seating differ from feeding a talking cupboard.
seedUse: D145-b invisible guest, Mum and extra chair; S02-b helps with orientation and assumes the next practical burden.
